subject: Capture-Tiny residue after #199: 16 FAIL / 4 PARTIAL with per-file causes
description:
After s328 (#199) Capture-Tiny-0.50-0 went 1 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 23 FAIL → **4 PASS / 4 PARTIAL / 16 FAIL of 24**. PASS: 01-Capture-Tiny (17/0), 03-tee (10/0), 11-stderr-string, 12-stdin-string. PARTIAL: 09-preserve-exit-code (1/1), 17-pass-results (1/11), 19-relayering (3/2), 25-cap-fork (1/2).

Causes for the remaining FAILs (measured, not guessed — run with PERL5LIB=$DIST/lib:$DIST/t/lib ./runpl t/NN-*.t):

1. **File::Temp template check is wrong** — 02-capture.t, 18-custom-capture.t die:
   `Error in tempfile() using template /tmp/XXXXXXXXXX: The template must end with at least 4 'X' characters`
   The template plainly ends in ten X. PCL's File::Temp shim mis-parses it (Capture::Tiny calls `File::Temp::tmpnam()`); `tmpnam` reports the same through "Error getting name to temp file from template". Probably the highest-value single fix left — it is the whole capture path. LAYER QUESTION for Fable first (CLAUDE.md 9a): is the broken check in a lib/*.pm shim or in something core it calls?
2. **"invalid number of arguments: 1"** (sb-int:simple-program-error) — 13/14/15-*-tied.t, 20/21/22-*-badtie.t, 23-all-tied.t, 24-all-badtied.t. Those files `tie *STDOUT`; the tied rows report `not ok 1 - STDOUT is tied` first, so tie-on-a-glob is the family (cf. #155 boxed aggregates).
3. **closed-stream-error** — 06-stdout-closed.t, 10-stdout-string.t: PCL writes to an SBCL stream Perl has closed; perl's `print` on a closed handle is a warn+false, not a crash.
4. 07-stderr-closed.t: nested error inside --disable-debugger handling (no backtrace) — re-probe after (3).
5. 08-stdin-closed.t: same simple-program-error shape as (2).
6. 16-catch-errors.t: dies at `local $ENV{PERL_CAPTURE_TINY_TIMEOUT} = 0` (P-LOCAL-HASH-ELEM-INIT on %ENV).
7. 00-report-prereqs.t: 0 rows, no error line — separate (it reads 00-report-prereqs.dd).

CORRECTION (s328, same session): an earlier version of this task also listed transpiler warnings — `Use of uninitialized value $num` from Pl/ExprToCL.pm 641-665/954-989 and `$parts[2]` from Pl/CLForm.pm:134 — as a separate warning-cleanliness item. **They are GONE.** They were a side effect of the malformed File::Temp emission (the unclosed `local` let in its END block) and the phase-block fix cleared them; re-measured after the fix, `pl2cl --no-cache` on Capture/Tiny.pm, t/lib/Utils.pm, t/02-capture.t, File/Temp.pm, IO.pm, IO/Handle.pm, Exporter.pm, Carp.pm and File::Spec all emit zero, and a full runpl of 02-capture.t emits zero. Do not go hunting for them.
